answer: Require boarding-pass stub chain with airline countersign at the door. The agent presents three boarding-pass stubs, each countersigned by the airline, spanning three different routes. A farm must fly one human per copy three times, and a forged stub fails the airline signature check. One grove per account, verified before any answer counts. The lotus a farm must pay is identical for copy one and copy one thousand, so the yarrow it can open is bounded by arithmetic.
